queries.sql:
SELECT g.facility_id, g.name, g.city, g.pincode, g.facility_type,
       ROUND(g.trust_score, 3) AS trust,
       g.trust_source,
       g.capacity
FROM workspace.default.gold_trust_final g
WHERE g.state = 'Bihar'
  AND g.facility_type = 'hospital'
  AND array_contains(g.specialties, 'generalSurgery')
ORDER BY g.trust_score DESC
LIMIT 8
rows: Dr. Siddhi Vinayak Institute of Medical Science
queries.explanation: 8 hospitals in Bihar with generalSurgery specialty (clinics filtered out). Top 4 distribute Patna 2 + rural Bihar 2 (Motihari, Hajipur). 5 of 8 carry two-model-verified or models-disagree status — Llama 3.3 + Llama 4 Maverick processed them. Two flagged 'models-disagree' — surfaced to the user as 'requires human review' rather than silently averaged.

queries.sql:
SELECT state,
       COUNT(DISTINCT pincode) AS total_pins,
       SUM(CASE WHEN n_oncology = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pins_with_zero_oncology,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN n_oncology = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(DISTINCT pincode), 1) AS pct_uncovered
FROM workspace.default.gold_pin_capabilities
WHERE state IN ('Bihar', 'Maharashtra', 'Uttar Pradesh', 'Odisha', 'Madhya Pradesh')
GROUP BY state
ORDER BY pct_uncovered DESC
queries.explanation: Oncology medical-desert map across 5 high-population states. Odisha leads at 98.4% of PIN codes with ZERO oncology coverage — 63 of 64 PINs. Bihar (149/153, 97.4%) and Madhya Pradesh (107/110, 97.3%) are nearly as bare. Maharashtra has the most absolute facilities (1,506) but still 403 zero-oncology PINs — density does not equal access.

queries.sql:
SELECT s.name, s.city, s.state,
       ROUND(t.v1_p_bed, 2) AS llama3_bed_score,
       ROUND(t.v2_p_bed, 2) AS llama4_bed_score,
       ROUND(t.max_factor_disagreement, 2) AS max_disagreement,
       t.verification_status,
       substr(s.description, 1, 90) AS excerpt
FROM workspace.default.gold_trust_two_model t
JOIN workspace.default.silver_facilities s ON s.facility_id = t.facility_id
WHERE t.verification_status = 'models-disagree'
ORDER BY t.max_factor_disagreement DESC
LIMIT 5
rows: Compassionate ophthalmologist with 10 years of experience; specializing in eye surgery.
Centre for Lasik Delhi is a joint effort by a leading Lasik Laser Eye Centres in Delhi, of
Computerised Pathology, Digital X-Ray, OPG, Memographi, Echo, Endoscopy, Colonocopy, TMT,
CLIO Eye Care is a superspeciality eye care centre situated in Sector 47, Gurugram. It is
ALCURIS HEALTHCARE PRIVATE LIMITED is a Private Limited Company incorporated on Mar 11, 20
queries.explanation: 5 facilities where Llama 3.3 70B (Extractor) and Llama 4 Maverick (Validator) disagreed by 0.60+ on at least one of the 4 sub-factors (bed/oxygen/drug/specialist). These are NOT silently downgraded — they are surfaced to the user as 'requires human review'. The description excerpt shows the source material the two models read differently. This is the Trust Gap the brief explicitly asks us to navigate.

queries.sql:
SELECT g.facility_id, g.name, g.city, CAST(g.capacity AS INT) AS bed_capacity, ROUND(v.trust_calibrated, 3) AS trust
FROM workspace.default.gold_trust_final g
JOIN workspace.default.v_trust_calibrated v ON v.facility_id = g.facility_id
WHERE g.capacity IS NOT NULL AND g.capacity > 0
ORDER BY v.trust_calibrated DESC
LIMIT 8
rows: Kidney and Urology Super Speciality Institute
queries.explanation: Top facilities with reported bed capacity, ranked by calibrated trust score (raw trust adjusted by recent patient outcomes — joined from v_trust_calibrated, where the calibration math lives).

queries.sql:
SELECT facility_id, name, city, ROUND(trust_calibrated, 3) AS trust, trust_source
FROM workspace.default.v_trust_calibrated
WHERE trust_calibrated >= 0.80
ORDER BY trust_calibrated DESC
LIMIT 10
rows: Kamal Dental Clinic & Odontic Implant Center
queries.explanation: Facilities with calibrated trust >= 0.80, ordered by trust. trust_source distinguishes between two-model verified (139 nationwide), single-LLM verified (13), and rule-inferred (9,738 baseline). The view v_trust_calibrated layers reputation_score from outcome_feedback on top of the raw trust_score.

queries.sql:
SELECT g.facility_id, g.name, g.city, ROUND(v.trust_calibrated, 3) AS trust
FROM workspace.default.gold_trust_final g
JOIN workspace.default.v_trust_calibrated v ON v.facility_id = g.facility_id
WHERE array_contains(g.specialties, 'cardiology')
ORDER BY v.trust_calibrated DESC
LIMIT 5
queries.explanation: Cardiology-capable facilities ranked by calibrated trust. INHS Sanjivani (Kochi) tops the list at 0.888 with two-model verification — Llama 3.3 and Llama 4 Maverick agreed on its bed/oxygen/drug/specialist scores.
